text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to increase her popularity, Haru Urara is helping to promote the shopping district. Always eager to help out, she happily goes about her tasks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When I speak with the shopkeepers, they credit her magnetic personality with revitalizing the once-downtrodden district.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the course of our conversation, they tell me that they don't care whether Haru Urara wins or loses, as long as she's running down the track happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, I wonder if it's really a good idea if that's all she races for.
